tab-selector.$description: TabSelector component tokens: AcmeCo's grey folder tabs (For Sale / For Lease / Auctions) at the top of the expanded filters panel, used as a single choice. Measured from the audit's captured CSS (styles 268 and 269 on 03-search-results-filters-open/02-search-results-filters-expanded-open-desktop). Audit family F16 listing-type selector: 34 instances, built 3 ways (these tabs, failing blue #0888ba text links, and a dropdown that Select now covers). Decision 24.

height.$description: OBSERVED: 46px unselected and 48px selected tabs; became 48px for the 4px grid.

padding-x.$description: OBSERVED: 21px; became 24px on the spacing scale.

gap.$description: OBSERVED: 20px between tabs; became 16px on the spacing scale.

border-width.$description: OBSERVED: 1px tab outlines and panel line.

line.$description: OBSERVED: 1px #dddddd line along the top of the panel; consolidated to the default border (#e5e5e5). Decorative.

background-hover.$description: PROPOSED: one step darker on hover. Not observed.

border.$description: OBSERVED: #dddddd outlines; consolidated to the default border (#e5e5e5).

text.$description: OBSERVED: #000000 labels; became ink (decision 5). 15.35:1 on the grey tab.

font-weight.$description: OBSERVED: 300 (light) unselected; became 400, the system's regular weight (decision 4).

background.$description: OBSERVED: white selected tab that opens into the panel below.

border.$description: PROPOSED: observed #dddddd; darkened so the selected tab's edge is 3.81:1 against the page and 3.43:1 against the grey tabs. AcmeCo's white-on-grey alone is about 1.1:1, below the 3:1 a selected state needs (WCAG 1.4.11; carried over from decision 21).

font-weight.$description: OBSERVED: 400 selected (vs 300 unselected); became 600, keeping a clear weight step (decision 4).
